description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of Reference Answer and Test Case," illustrates the distribution of three categories based on their counts: "Null" (549,238), "Have reference answer" (543,935), and "Have test case" (306,818). The largest segment, colored red, represents the "Null" category, which accounts for approximately 40.5% of the total. The blue segment, labeled "Have reference answer," constitutes 38.9% of the distribution. The green segment, "Have test case," makes up 21.9% of the total. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner that matches the colors to their respective categories and values, and each slice is labeled with its corresponding percentage. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the red "Null" slice.
